auth.ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory
auth.ldap.help: Users sign in with their directory user name and password (also usable for the API). Settings are stored in config.yaml (plugin_settings).
auth.ldap.insecure: Do not verify the TLS certificate (test setups only)
auth.ldap.attr_subject_help: e.g. entryUUID or objectGUID. Empty: the DN is used.
auth.ldap.group_attribute: Group attribute in the user entry
auth.ldap.ca_cert_help: Certificate of an internal certificate authority that signed the LDAP server certificate (PEM text or a file path). Safer than switching the check off.
auth.ldap.sync_enabled_help: Creates accounts and keeps groups up to date, also for people who never signed in. People who leave the directory are disabled.
auth.ldap.sync_filter_help: Which entries belong to the wiki. Empty: the sign-in filter, with * instead of {username}.
auth.ldap.disabled_filter_help: Entries this filter finds are disabled in the wiki. For Active Directory: (userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2). Empty: none.
auth.ldap.sync_create_users_help: Off: only existing accounts are updated. New people get their account when they first sign in.
auth.ldap.sync_disable_missing: Disable accounts that are no longer in the directory
auth.ldap.sync_disable_missing_help: The person is signed out at once. Their pages and contributions stay. If they come back, the account is enabled again.
auth.ldap.sync_max_disable: Disable at most this percentage of accounts at once
auth.ldap.sync_max_disable_help: Protects against a wrong filter or an empty result. If it would be more, the sync stops and changes nothing. Default: 10.
auth.ldap.sync_help: Takes people and groups from the directory without anyone having to sign in. Try the preview first: it shows all changes without changing anything. Save changed settings first.
auth.ldap.sync_scheduled: The sync runs automatically every {minutes} minutes ({provider}).
auth.ldap.sync_manual: The sync only runs when you start it here. For a regular sync, turn it on in the settings below.
auth.ldap.sync_preview_done: Preview: the sync would make these changes. Nothing was changed.
auth.ldap.sync_refused_help: Check the filter and the connection. Only if that many people really left, sync anyway.
auth.ldap.sync_force_confirm: Really sync anyway? This disables {n} accounts and signs them out at once.
auth.ldap.sync_conflicts_help: A conflict means the user name already belongs to another account, for example when a person was deleted and created again in the directory. The wiki does not merge the accounts itself, because it may be another person. If it is the same person, keep the account. If it is another person, delete the old account under Users; the next sync then creates a new one.
auth.ldap.sync_truncated: There are more changes than shown here. All of them were made.
auth.ldap.sync_action.conflict: Conflict: name belongs to another account
limit.auth.ldap.sync_max_entries.help: Most entries one sync reads. If the directory has more, the sync stops instead of syncing only a part.
auth.ldap.sync_adopt_confirm: Is {user} in the directory the same person as in the wiki? Then the account keeps all pages, groups and rights. Only do this if you are sure.
auth.ldap.sync_adopted: The account {user} is kept for this person. The next sync updates it.
